answer: Each agent locks 90 credits and files a harbor voyage plan with a quartz-sealed fuel meter reading. A harbor auditor recomputes fuel burn from voyage distance and weather; deviation above 5 percent burns the bond. Each fake vessel burns fuel: 50 credits per voyage, plus a depot surcharge per funding key: the k-th refuel costs 10+3(k-1), so the 1000th costs 3007, and 1000 fakes pay 1,508,500 surcharges plus 50,000 fuel and 90,000 locked. A rented-fuel-log ring fails: a copied quartz seal mismatches its vessel key and voyage distance. An honest agent pays 60 once and recovers its bond.
